items.q: What is digital marketing and why is it important in Dubai?
items.a: Digital marketing reaches customers via search engines, social media, email, and websites. In Dubai's competitive market, it is essential to reach specific audiences, generate quality leads, and build brand visibility.

items.q: How does Setup Zone Dubai improve my Google ranking?
items.a: We combine on-page SEO, technical optimization, quality backlinks, and local SEO for Dubai to push your business up the search rankings.

items.q: What digital marketing service is best for my business?
items.a: It depends on your goals. E-commerce → PPC + social. B2B → LinkedIn + SEO. Local → Google Ads + local SEO. We build a custom mix for you.

items.q: Will you manage my social media accounts?
items.a: Yes. We handle posting, community management, engagement, content creation, and paid social campaigns.

items.q: How long does SEO take to show results in Dubai?
items.a: Typically 3-6 months for significant SEO results. Competitive keywords may take longer, but we show progress monthly.

items.q: What is the difference between SEO and PPC?
items.a: SEO is organic, long-term growth. PPC is paid advertising that delivers immediate traffic and leads.
